Connect your account

juskel’s data partner, TrueLayer, would like 90-day access to your Mock account details.

What details am I sharing?

To provide its services, TrueLayer needs permission to access the following information and share it with juskel:

Full name
Account number and sort code
Balance
Transactions



TrueLayer is FCA-regulated, and won’t share or use your personal data for anything else.

To keep your information secure, TrueLayer connects to your account using bank-grade encryption.
